body.name: finite monotone primal-dual certificate algorithm
body.construction: For each prior-net point \(\lambda\), propagate \(F_\lambda\) with terminal datum \(\sum_{m=1}^M\lambda_mZ_m\ell_m\) backward on the displayed resolution schedule over vertex allocations by order-preserving multilinear interval interpolation. Integrate each Gaussian transition by outward-rounded cell probabilities on the truncated standardized Gaussian box and assign the certified Gaussian tail mass adversarially to the lower and upper ranges. Enclose every scenario oracle by the same recursion at point-mass priors, maximize the lower Bayes-regret bound over the finite prior net, solve the finite scenario-risk linear program over the resulting Bayes policies, and return its primal policy mixture and dual prior together with the separated interval error ledger.
